turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my printer is jamming again. Any quick fixes?
Hi Alan. Try opening the tray and gently pulling out any crumpled paper. Also, check if the rollers are dirty and clean them with a lint-free cloth.
That helped, thanks. Oh, and I just watched a video from a conference talk. Ashok Chandrasekar from Google discussed the reliability of LLM performance benchmarks. Pretty interesting stuff.
Good to hear the printer is working. Benchmark reliability is indeed a hot topic in AI research.
Yeah, exactly. Anyway, do you have any recommendations for a good Thai place nearby?
There's 'Bangkok Bites' about two blocks east. They're known for their Pad See Ew.
I'll check it out. Thanks, Lloyd.
Lloyd, what's the weather like for this weekend?
It looks like partly cloudy with highs around 75°F. A good day for a hike.
Nice. By the way, I finally found that video link I was looking for. Ashok Chandrasekar co-authored the video 'Are LLM Performance Benchmarks Reliable?'.
Glad you found it. That sounds like a useful resource if you're diving into model evaluation.
Definitely. I need to order some new mechanical keyboards. Any brands you like?
Keychron and Logitech are popular for reliability. If you want custom, check out Drop.
I'll look into Keychron. Thanks for the tip.
Happy to help. Let me know if you need specs.
